name: @pdpp/polyfill-connectors-vendored-source
description: Private source-only package for the remaining Google Messages connector and shared runtime helpers. This package.json keeps TypeScript ESM inference for files under this directory and ensures npm resolves the connector zod@4 dependency here. The local collector no longer compiles connector source; five connectors run from signed Collection Profiles. Do not add scripts, exports, or a public package identity here.
